description_for_human: Unofficial community tool to search an Oracle AI World 2026 catalog snapshot and build a conflict-aware agenda.
description_for_model: Use this unofficial community API to find Oracle AI World 2026 sessions, compare times, detect conflicts, and propose agendas. The data is a snapshot and can become stale. Always tell users to verify critical details in the official Oracle catalog. This tool is not affiliated with or endorsed by Oracle.
